text:
eve: Quick sync — we need to finalize the telemetry contract so product can ship per-tenant dashboards without leaking PII or exploding cardinality.

sam: +1. Major open questions: which fields are required from runtime (per-request) vs derived in infra, and API shape for ingesting tenant IDs.

jordan: I think runtime can emit low-cardinality tags every request: tenant_id (hashed), model, route, seq_len_bucket. Heavy fields like prompt text should never go in telemetry.

marta: For dashboards we need: request_count, tokens_out, p50/p95/p99 latency, kv_cache_hit_rate, gpu_util_pct, queued_requests, cost_estimate. Also an anomaly score for noisy-neighbor detection.

alex: Agree. For tenant_id hashing — we should use HMAC with org-specific salt so ops can map back only with RBAC. Avoid plaintext tenant IDs in metrics store.

sam: API debate: do we provide POST /observability/ingest with tenant in payload, or route by header X-Tenant-Id? Header allows routing without parsing body and is easier for proxies.

jordan: Header wins for low-cost routing + simpler sharding. But require signed header so we can trust tenant->org mapping. Put validation at edge.

marta: Dashboard UX: product wants a per-org toggle to 'show raw IDs' only for authorized users. Default must show hashed IDs and aggregated rollups.

alex: Noisy neighbor detection proposal: compute rolling baseline per-tenant (24h) and emit z-score for gpu_util and tail latency. Alert when z>4 and absolute p99>500ms. Add a sampling trace link to the console when triggered.

metrics-bot: new doc created: https://redwood.internal/infra/telemetry/tenant-contracts (draft)

eve: Questions for runtime team: can you add kv_cache_hit_rate and tokens_out to the streaming metrics? Also provide per-request routing_tag so we can correlate fallback events.

jordan: We can emit kv_cache_hit_rate as aggregated counter per-second; tokens_out is trickier for streaming — we'll emit token_count at end-of-stream event.

sam: Action items: (1) runtime: define ingest header + auth (owner: jordan) — due Tue EOD. (2) infra: schema + retention & rollups (owner: alex) — due Wed. (3) product/console: RBAC + per-org toggle (owner: marta) — demo next Thu. (4) SRE: noisy-neighbor alert thresholds + playbook (owner: sam) — draft Fri.

eve: Thanks — I'll slot a 30m handoff for Wed AM to walk through mappings. :calendar:

marta: I'll prototype dashboard wireframes and include 'export per-tenant cost' card.

alex: One more note: keep metric cardinality bounded — require a whitelist for any additional tenant-scoped labels. We'll ship whitelist config in infra.

sam: +1. Also add a hard quota on per-tenant custom metrics ingestion to avoid abuse.

eve: OK closing — will follow up with a PR referencing the doc. :thumbsup:
